name: jumble-api
description: JumbleAPI is a configless api to help frontend developers test how their application behaves under certain situations. It has options to save a schema, set delays for responses, return a certain or random status code, missing keys, wrong types, and malformed data. A simple API for generating random data using Faker.js and validating it with AJV.
author: Masato Mizunuma (Mizuto911)
